Share test

Both buttons use a sample addendum with made-up data. Each one shares a single file and nothing else.

Test 1: PDF only

Open rSuite Cloud to the Agreement Docs screen first. Then tap the button and look for rSuite Cloud in the share sheet, including under More.

Test 2: image for Photos

Tap the button and choose Save Image. Then in rSuite Cloud use Fly Docs, Browse Photos, and pick it. Check that the small print is readable.
